parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the specified resource. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes.
*   **false** no. This is the default value.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**, which indicates an Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: An array consisting of the IDs of instances from which you want to remove tags.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource to which the tag belongs. Set the value to **INSTANCE**, which indicates an Anti-DDoS Pro instance.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: An array consisting of the keys of the tags that you want to remove.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo delete-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --resource-type INSTANCE --all false --resource-ids ddoscoo-cn-zvp2eibz0000 --tag-key doc-test-key --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo DeleteTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm2pz25js0000' --ResourceIds.1 'ddoscoo-cn-zvp2eibz0000' --TagKey.1 'doc-test-key' --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
